gameAccounts.help: So others can find you on Steam, EA and co. The “Playing now” agent fills in Steam automatically; maintain the rest here. Visible to all signed-in participants.
gameAccounts.steamHint: Steam fills in by itself once the “Playing now” agent runs on your PC.

gameAccounts.overview.help: To add each other as friends.

presence.setup.privacy: Voluntary: only the detected game is reported, never the list of your programs. Who plays what is kept in memory only; two minutes after the agent stops, your entry is gone. The agent also adds your Steam account (ID and display name, never the login name) to your game accounts.
presence.setup.noAgent: This installation has no bundled agent. The organisers can build it from tools/game-agent.
presence.setup.createError: That did not work, please try again.
presence.setup.steps: 1. Download the agent. 2. Download the start file and put it into the same folder. 3. Double-click the start file and keep the window open.
presence.setup.tokenNote: The start file contains your personal agent key. It can only report games, nothing else. Still, don't share it; “Sign out agent” invalidates it.
presence.setup.smartscreen: Windows warns on first start (“Windows protected your PC”) because the agent is not signed. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
presence.setup.keyStatus: Agent set up on {created}, last report: {used}. Setting it up again invalidates the old start file.
